description: This file contains the class definition for `Smarty_Template_Cached`, which is a cache data container for Smarty template files. It manages cached template data, verifies cache validity, and handles cache rendering, invalidation, and locking mechanisms within the Smarty templating engine.

classes.name: Smarty_Template_Cached
classes.description: Represents cached data for a Smarty template, handling cache validation, rendering, and locking.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the cache object with template properties and loads the cache resource handler.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Static method to instantiate and initialize a cache object for a given template.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the cached template, processing it if necessary.

methods.name: isCached
methods.description: Checks if the cache is valid and manages cache locking based on cache validity conditions.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes the cache using the cache resource handler.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads cached content via the handler if not recompiled.
